name: Medusa
description: Automatic Video Library Manager for TV Shows. It watches for new episodes of your favorite shows, and when they are posted it does its magic.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  medusa:
    container_name: medusa
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 7848M
    environment:
      - TZ= $TZ
    image: pymedusa/medusa:master
    ports:
      - target: 8081
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}
        target: /config
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/Downloads/Television
        target: /downloads
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/Media/Television
        target: /tv
    network_mode: bridge
    privileged: false
